environment.description: Same Kubernetes pod and code deployed in the staging-restricted namespace. DATABASE_URL connects to the same PostgreSQL 14 cluster but authenticates as role 'activity_ro_ingest'. This role was provisioned via Terraform module 'pg_restricted_role' with grant specification limited to read-path operations. The pg_hba.conf entry for this role enforces hostssl with client certificate CN matching 'svc-activity-consumer'. Role attributes: NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOINHERIT. The role is a member of the 'readonly_group' which has SELECT granted on activity_log, users, and sessions tables only. No explicit INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE grants exist on any table for this role or any role it inherits from. The pg_catalog.pg_roles entry shows rolcanlogin=true but the effective privilege set via has_table_privilege() returns false for INSERT on all relations.

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT ON TABLE activity_log, users, sessions TO readonly_group; GRANT readonly_group TO activity_ro_ingest;
